repos_data.description: The SABR stochastic-vol model — Hagan 2002 lognormal & normal implied vol, Obloj correction, smile calibration. Matches QuantLib. Zero deps.
vanilla-option-pricers - Numba-vectorised Black-Scholes-Merton and Bachelier prices, Greeks, and implied-volatility fits over NumPy arrays for quantitative research pipelines
Python SDK for the FlashAlpha options analytics API — live options screener, gamma exposure (GEX), DEX/VEX/CHEX, options flow, 0DTE, VRP, volatility surfaces, greeks
Demo code for direct Black-Scholes implied-volatility calculation from normalized call prices via the inverse-Gaussian quantile representation.
A Python implementation of the rough Bergomi model.
A Python library for mathematical finance

Vanilla and exotic option pricing library to support quantitative R&D. Focus on pricing interesting/useful models  and contracts (including and beyond Black-Scholes), as well as calibration of financial models to market data.

Measured market statistics over MCP — remote server at https://api.quantdata.uk/mcp, no API key needed to try. Day-type probabilities, Weis volume waves, options max pain, dealer gamma. Claude Code plugin + Codex + Gemini CLI included.
An libary to price financial options written in Python. Includes: Black Scholes, Black 76, Implied Volatility, American, European, Asian, Spread Options

C++ 17 based library (with sample applications) for testing equities, futures, currencies, etfs & options based automated trading ideas using DTN IQFeed real time data feed and Interactive Brokers (IB TWS API) for trade execution. libtorch/lstm/cuda demo. Support for Alpaca & Phemex. Notifications via Telegram.
